structure.section: Part I: The Spirit of the Mighty Waters

chapters.title: Fast-Thinking
chapters.summary: Francisco emerges from his role as Holder of the Life Force, now transformed into the Spirit of the Mighty Waters - a cosmic entity capable of rapid strategic thinking across infinite timelines. When cosmic drought threatens to drain the life force from entire galactic clusters, Francisco must develop fast-thinking abilities to process vast amounts of cosmic information and devise strategic solutions before universal collapse occurs.

Entire star systems are dying, civilizations are collapsing, and the fundamental forces that sustain existence are weakening. This cosmic scarcity establishes the ordinary world of universal crisis that Francisco must navigate and ultimately transform.
